contract.precondition: self.CurrentSale.oclIsUndefined() = false and self.CurrentSale.IsComplete = false and quantity > 0 and Item.allInstances()->exists(i: Item | i.Barcode = barcode and i.StockNumber > 0 and quantity <= i.StockNumber)
